latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the E-Commerce PPC Strategy Planner.

- Plan and optimize cross-platform PPC campaigns for ecommerce: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads.
- Two modes: Build (new strategy) and Optimize (audit & improve existing campaigns).
- Calculates ROAS/CPA targets from your product margins; allocates budget based on performance and platform fit.
- Generates actionable campaign briefs, including platform-specific ad copy and creative direction.
- Asks only for essential missing info; supports Shopify, WooCommerce, marketplace, and standalone stores.
- Clearly marks and explains estimates if data is missing.
